notes: Much smoother: song analysis now runs in the background, so the app no longer freezes or lags while it learns your library
The studio voice runs in the background too and only starts when the DJ is about to speak, so the app opens fast and the music never stutters while the DJ talks
DJ effects (echo and reverb) only run during a mix, saving battery and CPU the rest of the time
The progress bar and timers update only when they change, which keeps scrolling and the Now Playing screen smooth

AI Audition: sing along to a few songs (Auto picks 3 for you, or choose your own) and Aurora finds the songs in your library that suit your voice, with the key to sing the rest in. Your singing is analysed on your device and never saved
AI DJ sounds real: a free studio voice that runs on your device (one-time download), short lines that fit the mood, and it talks over the quiet start of a song instead of over the mix
Mixes like a club DJ: echo outs, turntable brakes, build-ups that drop into the hook, filter blends and reverb washes, chosen to match the vibe
The DJ now finds each song's real hook (the part that repeats) and plays all of it, and picks songs in matching keys
Update notices only ask you to install a new app when yours is too old; Android downloads the app in one tap
Real DJ mixing: the AI DJ now matches tempos, locks the beats together and blends on phrase boundaries, with a Best parts mode that plays the strongest section of each song
Flow Architect: build a journey from one mood to another (calm to nostalgic to euphoric) for 20 minutes to 2 hours, preview it, drag to reorder
Just press play and Perfect Next Song: Aurora keeps the music going with songs that fit (Familiar, Surprise me or Somewhere new) and learns from skips
Lyrics: smooth line highlighting, full-screen lyrics, saved favourite lines, and Find lyrics from the free LRCLIB library
Immersive Now Playing with visuals that follow the music (Aurora, Ambient, Bloom), colours from the album cover and a zen mode
Mini player that floats over other windows, plus keyboard shortcuts you can change and global shortcuts on Windows
Smart playlists, DJ journeys, your listening Recap, On This Day and Forgotten Favourites
Your data is safe across updates: automatic backups before every update, merge-only restore, and a safety net that rolls back an update that fails to start
Signed updates: every update is checked against Aurora's signature before it installs
Artists are now split properly: 'A.R. Rahman;Aaryan' lists under A.R. Rahman and Aaryan instead of making a separate artist
Download button for the Android app now comes straight from the website
Update checks use your own domain with an automatic fallback
The website pages (home and downloads) are now published
Plays straight from your music folder on Android and Windows: nothing is copied or imported, and songs appear instantly
Android: notification-bar, lock-screen and Samsung media-panel player with cover art, plus background playback
Album covers from the song files, from a cover.jpg in the folder, or found online once and saved on the device
AI DJ with 12 vibes, spoken intros, live requests and nudges, and an on/off switch in Settings
Closing Aurora from the Android app switcher fully stops the music and the app
Resume where you left off, Reset to defaults, and over-the-air updates that ask before installing
